# Luna Graphics

> Luna Graphics is a print shop and branding company based in Nairobi, Kenya, offering large format printing, UV printing, CNC cutting, laser cutting, plotting, DTF printing, sublimation printing, digital printing, custom merchandise, and corporate/political campaign branding. Physical location: Kweria Road, Nairobi CBD (near Khoja Stage).

Contact: +254 791 159 618 · info@lunagraphics.co.ke
Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00–18:00, Sat 9:00–16:00

## Services

- [Large Format Printing](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/services/large-format): Posters, banners, billboards, backdrops up to 5m wide.
- [UV Printing](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/services/uv-printing): Direct printing on rigid and flexible materials, acrylic, glass, wood, metal.
- [CNC Cutting](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/services/cnc-cutting): Precision cutting and fabrication for signage, displays, architectural panels.
- [Laser Cutting](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/services/laser-cutting): Detailed cutting and engraving for signage and custom projects.
- [Plotting](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/services/plotting): Vinyl cutting for stickers, decals, vehicle graphics.
- [T-Shirt Printing](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/services/t-shirt-printing): Screen printing and custom apparel for events, campaigns, teams.
- [DTF Printing](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/services/dtf-printing): Direct-to-film printing, no minimum order, suited to small runs and samples.
- [Sublimation Printing](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/services/sublimation-printing): Full-color printing on fabric and hard goods (mugs, apparel).
- [Digital Printing](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/services/digital-printing): Flyers, business cards, and short-run print collateral.
- [Corporate & Political Campaign Services](https://lunagraphics.co.ke/corporate-services): Large-scale branding for corporate rebrands, exhibitions, and election campaigns — case studies and past client results included.
